Final blows with this weapon generate melee energy. 
Dealing melee damage briefly improves this weapon's handling.

Final blows with this weapon generate improved melee energy.

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.description:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

enhanced.name: Elemental Capacitor
enhanced.description:
Substantially increases stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

perks.name: Fragile Focus
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

enhanced.name: Fragile Focus
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns more quickly once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.description: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Threat Detector
enhanced.description: Greatly increased reload, stability, and handling when targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Slideshot
perks.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability.

enhanced.name: Slideshot
enhanced.description: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts range and stability greatly.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Slice
perks.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

enhanced.name: Slice
enhanced.description: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for an improved duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Paracausal Affinity
perks.description: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for a short period of time. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.

enhanced.name: Paracausal Affinity
enhanced.description: Final blows of energy types matching this weapon's alignment grant increased damage for an improved duration. Light final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Darkness final blows boost Stasis and Strand weapons.

perks.name: Barrel Constrictor
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon reduce its projectile spread for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Barrel Constrictor
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon significantly reduce its projectile spread for an improved duration.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

enhanced.name: Surrounded
enhanced.description: This weapon gains improved bonus damage when three or more targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Sword Logic
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

enhanced.name: Sword Logic
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. The strength and duration of the bonus increases when more powerful targets are defeated.

perks.name: One-Two Punch
perks.description: Hitting an enemy with every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

enhanced.name: One-Two Punch
enhanced.description: Hitting a target with nearly every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.description: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

enhanced.name: Opening Shot
enhanced.description: Greatly improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

enhanced.name: Hatchling
enhanced.description: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location. There's a chance to spawn an increased amount of Threadlings.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

enhanced.name: Chaos Reshaped
enhanced.description: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time, activating faster. Remaining in combat for a slightly reduced duration rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

enhanced.name: Aggregate Charge
enhanced.description: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target. Damage bonus is increased.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

flavor: If you're going to face down a Knight with an ascendant blade, bring an ascendant gun.
